device.description: Device name used for reading TOC and media info (e.g., /dev/scd0). Must be readable.

scsi_device.description: SCSI device identifier passed to cdrecord as dev=, in form 'scsibus,target,lun'.

speed.description: Write speed passed to cdrecord as speed=.

padding.description: Padding in 2048-byte sectors passed to cdrecord as padsize=.

xa2_mode.description: Enable CDROM XA2 mode (affects only CD media, not DVD).

dvd_mode.description: Enable DVD writing mode. Incompatible with multi-session.

image_path.description: Path to virtual image file (enables virtual image mode). Required if using -w later.

media_size.description: Explicit media size (e.g., '700', '4488m', '350000s'). Required for virtual image mode; optional otherwise for manual override.

disable_crc.description: Disable CRC checksum creation (not recommended; saves ~0.2% space).

media_change_cmd.description: Command/script to prompt for media change in multi-disk mode. Receives device name as argument.

multi_disk.description: Enable multi-disk mode to span backup across multiple media.

debug.description: Enable DEBUG output (not for normal use).

cdrecord_extra_opts.description: List of additional options passed directly to cdrecord(1) after '--' separator.
